title: agropyron kingianum
intro: Agropyron kingianum, commonly known as wheat grass, is a type of young grass that belongs to the wheat family and is harvested within 2-3 weeks of its germination. The health benefits of wheat grass include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and detoxifier, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and remove toxins from the body. The therapeutic actions of wheat grass include its potential to support digestive health, boost the immune system, and lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of wheat grass include chlorophyll, vitamins A, C, and E, as well as minerals such as iron, calcium, and potassium.
